across education, healthcare, telecom, and enterprise products.

work.title: Case studies on Behance
work.note: Six case studies spanning fintech, e-commerce, wellness and EdTech. Full breakdowns and screens live on Behance.

projects.title: NIKE Shoes
focus: Interaction-flow case study for a shoe e-commerce experience
Focused on navigation clarity and visual hierarchy across product discovery
Designed engaging micro-interaction patterns to guide users through key decision points

projects.title: BundleBee
focus: End-to-end UX/UI for a product-bundling platform
Simplified complex bundling decisions through clear information architecture
Structured flows to reduce cognitive load when comparing bundle options

projects.title: MindEase
focus: UX/UI case study for a mind-and-fitness wellness app
Calm, distraction-free visual design to support mindfulness routines
Structured onboarding and tracking flows for daily fitness and mental-wellness habits

projects.title: Stock Broker App
focus: Case study for a stock-trading and investment app
Simplified dense financial data into clear, scannable views
Designed trade-flow interactions balancing speed with clarity for time-sensitive decisions

projects.title: SkillSage
focus: UX/UI case study for a skill-learning and upskilling platform
Structured course discovery and progress tracking for learners
Applied clear information architecture to guide users toward relevant skill paths

projects.title: Movie Booking App
focus: Fast-path booking case study for a cinema ticketing app
Optimized seat-selection flow to cut steps and confusion
Focused on reducing drop-off across the booking funnel

experience.title: Where I've delivered
experience.note: Five-plus years across product design and — before that — backend and full-stack engineering, which now shapes how I hand off design work.

bullets: Dedicated to bridging the gap between business strategy and user-centric design, ensuring every product decision is rooted in both user needs and business objectives.
Maintain a high-touch partnership with developers, delivering robust design architecture and optimized assets that streamline the development lifecycle.
Monitor user behaviour and execute integrated social network campaigns to consistently enhance brand presence while ensuring designs are technically viable and performance-driven.

Directly contributed to and managed four major products: Miles Website, Miles One App (Google Play Store & Apple App Store), MOJO Campus Website (PG/rental platform for students), and the Miles One LMS.
Oversee end-to-end developer collaboration across all four products, leading pre and post-development testing on LIVE environments to ensure quality and design fidelity.
Represented the company at a Microsoft Copilot Studio hackathon in Zurich, Switzerland, demonstrating advanced expertise and innovative problem solving in AI driven solutions.
Pioneered and developed a custom GrapesJS ecosystem, providing a robust, no code platform for users to create and edit webpages through intuitive drag and drop functionality, similar to Wix.

Conducted in-depth discussions with project stakeholders and clients to meticulously gather and clarify requirements, while proactively offering strategic recommendations for enhanced user experience (UX) and interface (UI) design, directly contributing to high user engagement.
Led the development and deployment of over 20 SharePoint sites, enhancing collaboration and information accessibility across the organization.
Implemented and integrated 10+ Copilot agent solutions, significantly extending capabilities for intelligent automation and user support within the SharePoint environment.
Utilized Hugo (Markdown-based component framework) to efficiently build and manage static web pages, ensuring high performance and maintainability.
Successfully designed, implemented, and delivered versions 1 through 4 of a comprehensive, human-centric Learning Management System (LMS) for B2B and B2C audiences globally.

Led the full UX lifecycle: gathered stakeholder requirements, defined strategic UX/UI specifications, created personas and user journey maps, and translated insights into detailed design documentation.
Acted as Design Lead — overseeing the design vision, mentoring on best practices, and providing direct front-end support to ensure seamless, high-quality implementation across all devices.
Delivered wireframes, interactive Figma prototypes, and production-ready design assets with thorough developer handoff documentation.
Ran iterative usability testing cycles and incorporated feedback loops to refine the product experience across each version release.
Ensured full responsive design coverage across desktop, tablet, and mobile, maintaining consistency with the established design system.

roles.company: Skyvera LLC (formerly Sterlite Technologies) / STL Telecom
bullets: Continued responsibilities seamlessly post-acquisition of Sterlite Technologies Ltd. by Skyvera LLC.
Successfully delivered the Go-Live project for MTN Sudan — a landmark digital transformation initiative.
Served as part of the CAL (Component Access Layer) team actively involved in the Go-Live project for MTN Sudan.
Worked with the CAL BSS product team prior to Go-Live; proficient in SpringBoot, API, Postman, and Kubernetes.
Followed Agile/Scrum processes with Jira, GitLab, and Git for version control and project management.
Worked as part of the R&D team on the core product myWorkplace as a full-stack developer using the proprietary MosaicJS framework — similar to the MERN stack (MongoDB, ExpressJS, ReactJS, NodeJS).
Contributed to feature development and code reviews following Agile/Scrum practices with Jira and GitHub.
Performed API testing and integration using Postman; applied MVC model architecture and SonarQube for code quality assurance.
Designed responsive UI components, screen layouts, and user flows for internal digital products using Figma, Adobe XD, and Miro.
Created wireframes and interactive prototypes aligned to user personas and product goals defined in collaboration with senior designers.
Applied UX principles including usability heuristics, accessibility standards, and visual hierarchy to produce polished, user-friendly interfaces.
Participated in design critique sessions, incorporating feedback to refine and iterate on interface designs before final handoff.

skills.title: What I bring to a team
skills.note: Design-systems depth backed by a year of hands-on backend and full-stack engineering — I know what's realistic to hand off.

about.headline: I design production-ready UI and the systems that keep it consistent — across markets, platforms, and teams.
paragraphs: I'm a Google-certified Senior UX/UI Designer with 5+ years of experience designing meaningful digital products across EdTech, HealthTech, Telecom, and enterprise ecosystems. My approach combines user research, interaction design, usability principles, and scalable design systems to create experiences that are intuitive, accessible, and impactful.

With an engineering foundation in backend and full-stack development, I bring a unique perspective to product design by bridging the gap between user needs, business goals, and technical possibilities.
